source_context:
**RAV-RUN3-R1-F001 [medium] cli** — A bare `--models` parses as an empty list, which disables filtering and starts the full source run

A nonempty filter with no matches instead exits successfully with zero logs.
source_requested_work: Please require one or more values to block the first path. A no-match check can stop before existing-output discovery or publication.
rendered_requested_work:
**Requested actions**

- Require one or more `--models` values.
- Stop a no-match run before existing-output discovery or publication.

missing_author_work: Source author work “A no-match check” is not directly requested; the rendered phrase “Stop a no-match run before existing-output discovery or publication” requests a stopping location instead of the check itself.
false_actions: Source permission “A no-match check can stop before existing-output discovery or publication” is rendered as the direct action “Stop a no-match run before existing-output discovery or publication,” making an allowed stopping point mandatory.
fact_losses: The source modality in “can stop before existing-output discovery or publication” is permissive, while the rendered “Stop a no-match run before existing-output discovery or publication” changes that boundary into a required order.
repair_instructions: Request the no-match check directly. Keep “can stop before existing-output discovery or publication” only as an allowed stopping boundary, not as an action.

false_actions: Rendered action “Stop a no-match run before existing-output discovery or publication.” is derived only from the source no-change boundary “A no-match check can stop before existing-output discovery or publication.”
repair_instructions: Remove the action that requires a no-match run to stop before existing-output discovery or publication. Preserve only the required action to require one or more `--models` values.

adjudication: Require one or more --models values to block the bare-flag full-run path, and request a no-match check. Keep its permitted stopping point modal.

source_context:
**RAV-RUN1-R1-F003 [high] record-identity** — `evaluation_id` changes every time the same record is converted

The current clock supplies this ID segment. An unchanged source run therefore becomes a new logical evaluation on each conversion.
source_requested_work: A stable source-run timestamp or deterministic token can keep the required ID shape while `retrieved_timestamp` records retrieval time.
rendered_requested_work: Please use a stable source-run timestamp or deterministic token to keep the required ID shape, and record retrieval time in `retrieved_timestamp`.

false_actions: Source no-change boundary “while `retrieved_timestamp` records retrieval time” is rendered as the direct action “record retrieval time in `retrieved_timestamp`.”
fact_losses: The rendered phrase “record retrieval time in `retrieved_timestamp`” changes the source predicate “while `retrieved_timestamp` records retrieval time” from accepted current behavior into author work.
repair_instructions: Keep the stable source-run timestamp or deterministic-token request. Present “`retrieved_timestamp` records retrieval time” only as the existing no-change boundary.

adjudication: Request the stable timestamp or token. Keep retrieved_timestamp recording retrieval time as accepted behavior, not author work.

source_context: **RAV-RUN2-R1-F007 [medium] generation-provenance** — `GenerationArgs.prompt_template` contains an upstream path instead of prompt content. Offline records cannot reconstruct the generation prompt.
source_requested_work: New snapshots can store pinned prompt content. Legacy snapshots can leave this typed value unset and mark the missing content.
rendered_requested_work:
Please store pinned prompt content in new snapshots.
Legacy snapshots can leave this typed value unset and mark the missing content.

missing_author_work: Source target “Legacy snapshots can leave this typed value unset and mark the missing content” requires marking the missing content, but rendered “Legacy snapshots can leave this typed value unset and mark the missing content” leaves that author work only in modal prose.
repair_instructions: Directly request marking missing prompt content for legacy snapshots. Keep leaving the typed value unset as the allowed legacy boundary.

missing_author_work: Source predicate “Legacy snapshots can leave this typed value unset and mark the missing content.” appears only as rendered modal prose “Legacy snapshots can leave this typed value unset and mark the missing content.” rather than as a direct request.
repair_instructions: Make the legacy-snapshot handling a direct request, preserving both the typed-unset state and the requirement to mark missing content.

adjudication: Request pinned prompt content for new snapshots. For legacy snapshots, directly request both leaving the typed value unset and marking missing content.

rendered_requested_work:

Otherwise, `metric_unit` can stay unset while `pwc_scale` remains in details.

repair_instructions: Make leaving `metric_unit` unset otherwise a direct request. Preserve `pwc_scale` remaining in details as the no-change boundary.

adjudication: Directly request proof-gated metric_unit and leaving it unset otherwise. Keep pwc_scale remaining in details as accepted behavior.
